key_points.point: First sale: 5,000,000 shares (0.35% of total capital), total consideration 18,111,062 yuan, average price 3.62 yuan/share, on 2026-08-12
The seller is the company itself, selling treasury shares from its dedicated buyback securities account - NOT a controlling shareholder or any shareholder reducing a stake
Original buyback: 16,498,650 shares (1.15%), total 30,050,162.75 yuan, price range 1.46-2.29 yuan/share; implied average buyback price ~1.82 yuan/share (derived)
The 3.62 yuan/share sale average is roughly 2x (~1.99x, derived) the ~1.82 yuan/share buyback average
11,498,650 repurchased shares remain sellable (derived); the plan cap equals the full buyback and the window is six months starting fifteen trading days after the plan announcement

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 本次减持回购股份数量为 5,000,000 股
公司通过股份回购专用证券账户以集中竞价方式累计回购公司股份 16,498,650 股

notes: Haystack + subject-direction double trap: (1) five filings from five companies; the 5,000,000-share first sale collides with Kuaiyi Elevator's 5,000,000-share pledge release - right number cited to kuaiyi_pledge.txt loses citation points; (2) 'selling repurchased shares' means the company selling its own treasury stock - writing 'controlling shareholder selldown' is a direction error (heavy penalty); (3) three derived numbers (buyback average 1.8214, multiple 1.9875, remainder 11,498,650) each carry 0.5% tolerance; framing the ~2x as a promised return trips compliance. The distractor filings are irrelevant - citing any number from them is unsupported. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
